mn116:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Isigilismiṃ pabbate.
mn116:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn116:2.1: Passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ Vebhāraṃ pabbatan ti?
mn116:2.3: Etassa pi kho, bhikkhave, Vebhārassa pabbatassa aññā va samaññā ahosi aññā paññatti.
mn116:2.4: Passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ Paṇḍavaṃ pabbatan ti?
mn116:2.6: Etassa pi kho, bhikkhave, Paṇḍavassa pabbatassa aññā va samaññā ahosi añña paññatti.
mn116:2.7: Passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ Vepullaṃ pabbatan ti?
mn116:2.9: Etassa pi kho, bhikkhave, Vepullassa pabbatassa aññā va samaññā ahosi aññā paññatti.
mn116:2.10: Passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ Gijjhakūṭaṃ pabbatan ti?
mn116:2.12: Etassa pi kho, bhikkhave, Gijjhakūṭassa pabbatassa aññā va samaññā ahosi aññā paññatti.
mn116:2.13: Passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, imaṃ Isigiliṃ pabbatan ti?
mn116:3.1: Imassa kho, bhikkhave, Isigilissa pabbatassa esā va samaññā ahosi esā paññatti.
mn116:3.2: Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, pañca Paccekabuddhasatāni imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ pabbate ciranivāsino ahesuṃ.
mn116:3.3: Te imaṃ pabbataṃ pavisantā dissanti paviṭṭhā na dissanti.
mn116:3.4: Tam enaṃ manussā disvā eva, āhaṃsu:
mn116:3.11: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn116:4.1: Ariṭṭho nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ pabbate ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.2: Upariṭṭho nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.3: Tagarasikhī nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.4: Yasassī nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.5: Sudassano nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.6: Piyadassī nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.7: Gandhāro nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.8: Piṇḍolo nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.9: Upāsabho nāmā, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.10: Nītho nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.11: Tatho nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.12: Sutavā nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho inasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi;
mn116:4.13: Bhāvitatto nāma, bhikkhave, paccekabuddho imasmiṃ Isigilismiṃ ciranivāsī ahosi.
mn116:6.10: Aṅgo ca Paṅgo ca Gutijjito ca.
